title: isolepis trollii
intro: Isolepis trollii, commonly known as the "blue sedge," is a type of aquatic plant belonging to the family Cyperaceae. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its ability to help clear mucus from the airways. The therapeutic actions of Isolepis trollii include its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
